consequence.statement: The new field is optional. When it is unset, the service discovery role falls back to the value defined in the Prometheus/PrometheusAgent resource, so existing ServiceMonitors need no action.

assertion.statement: An optional field, spec.serviceDiscoveryRole, was added to the monitoring.coreos.com/v1 ServiceMonitor schema. It accepts "Endpoints" or "EndpointSlice". When it is unset, the role defined in the Prometheus/PrometheusAgent resource applies.
